```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load data

```{r}
df_loss <- 
  readr::read_rds("data_out/df_descriptives.rds") %>% 
  filter(age_loss <= 20.5)
```

Get rid of non-discordant pairs that do not make it into the main analysis

```{r}
fit_to_exclude <- 
  fixest::feglm(is_anypsy_anytime_all ~ 1|fam_link,
                family = "binomial",
                data = df_loss)

df_loss_excl <-
  df_loss %>%
  filter(!fam_link %in% fit_to_exclude$fixef_removed$fam_link)
```


### Age of loss

```{r}
df_loss_excl %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = age_loss)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(x = "Age of parental loss", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
```

### Outcome counts 

```{r}
df_loss_excl %>% 
  summarize(across(starts_with("is_"), sum)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>% 
  mutate(pct = value/nrow(df_loss),
         n_pct = paste0(prettyNum(value, big.mark = ","),
                        "\n(", sprintf("%.1f", pct*100), "%)"),
         outc = case_when(str_detect(name, "anypsy") ~ "Any psychiatric disorder",
                          str_detect(name, "dep") ~ "Depression",
                          str_detect(name, "anx") ~ "Anxiety",
                          str_detect(name, "sub") ~ "Substance abuse",
                          str_detect(name, "bip") ~ "Bipolar disorder",
                          str_detect(name, "neu") ~ "Neurodevelopmental disorder",
                          str_detect(name, "per") ~ "Personality disorder",
                          str_detect(name, "psc") ~ "Psychotic disorder",
                          str_detect(name, "sle") ~ "Sleep disorder",
                          str_detect(name, "str") ~ "Stress-related disorder")) %>% 
  drop_na(outc) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = reorder(outc, value))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_pct), nudge_x = 400, 
            lineheight = .8) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off", xlim = c(300, 6000)) +
  labs(x = "Count", y = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
```

Table 1

```{r}
median(df_loss_excl$age_loss)
df_loss_excl %>% count(fam_link) %>% filter(n>2)
```
```{r}
df_loss_excl %>% 
  mutate(fu_years = follow_up_years,
         age_loss_cat = ifelse(age_loss < 17, "Age at parental loss before 18", "Age at parental loss 18-20"),
         age_loss_cat = fct_relevel(age_loss_cat, "Age at parental loss before 18"),
         which_parent,
         unnatural_death = unnatural_death == 1, 
         sex = sex == 1, 
         birth_country, 
         psy_family = psy_family == 1,
         psy_history = preexist_diag,
         birth_country = case_when(birth_country == "Sverige" ~ "Sweden",
                                   birth_country == "Asien" ~ "Asia",
                                   birth_country %in% c("Europa utom EU27 och Norden",
                                                        "Norden utom Sverige",
                                                        "EU27 utom Norden") ~ "Europe",
                                   birth_country == "Afrika" ~ "Africa",
                                   birth_country == "Sydamerika" ~ "South America",
                                   birth_country == "Nordamerika" ~ "North America"),
         across(starts_with("is_"), as.logical),
         # is_any_mh = ifelse(is_any_mh == 1, "Developed mental illness", "Did not develop mental illness"),
         .keep = "none") %>% 
  relocate(fu_years, sex, birth_country, which_parent, unnatural_death,
           psy_family, psy_history, is_anypsy_anytime_all) %>% 
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(by = "age_loss_cat",
                         sort = gtsummary::all_categorical(FALSE) ~ "frequency",
                         statistic = list(fu_years ~ "{sum}"),
                         label = list(sex = "Sex (male)",
                                      birth_country = "National origin",
                                      # income = "Household income, euros",
                                      which_parent = "Parent lost",
                                      unnatural_death = "Cause of parental death (sudden)",
                                      psy_family = "Mental illness in family",
                                      psy_history = "Mental illness in index child before loss",
                                      fu_years = "Person years, total",
                                      fu_mean_years = "Person years, average",
                                      is_anypsy_anytime_all = "Any psychiatric disorder",
                                      is_dep_anytime_all = "Depression diagnosis",
                                      is_anx_anytime_all = "Anxiety diagnosis",
                                      is_sub_anytime_all = "Substance abuse diagnosis",
                                      is_bip_anytime_all = "Bipolar disorder",
                                      is_neu_anytime_all = "Neurodevelopmental disorder",
                                      is_per_anytime_all = "Personality disorder",
                                      is_psc_anytime_all = "Psychotic disorder",
                                      is_sle_anytime_all = "Sleep disorder",
                                      is_str_anytime_all = "Stress-related disorder")) %>% 
  gtsummary::add_overall() %>% 
  gtsummary::as_gt() %>% 
  gt::opt_table_lines(extent = "none") |>
  gt::tab_options(
      data_row.padding = gt::px(1),
      heading.border.bottom.width = 2,
      heading.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      table.border.top.color = "white",
      table_body.border.top.width = 1,
      heading.title.font.size = 13,
      table.font.size = 12,
      table_body.border.bottom.width = 1,
      table_body.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      column_labels.border.bottom.width = 1)

```
